item.title: Localized High-Concentration Electrolyte with Nonfluorinated Diluent for Wide-Temperature Sodium-Ion Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using low-cost, nonfluorinated toluene as a diluent to create a 1M localized high-concentration electrolyte for wide-temperature sodium-ion batteries. Its significance is enabling stable antimonene anode performance from −20 to 50 °C and revealing a "breathable" solid electrolyte interphase that adapts thickness and composition, accommodating volume changes and ensuring efficient Na+ transport.
🏷 localized high-concentration electrolyte · nonfluorinated diluent · sodium-ion battery · wide-temperature · solid electrolyte interphase

item.title: Spatial Confinement Enables In Situ Growth of the Nano-Sn@Sn3(PO4)2 Anode for Sodium-Ion Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a dealloying-induced phase transformation and spatial confinement strategy that in situ constructs a robust Sn3(PO4)2 coating on Sn nanoparticles, preventing aggregation and sustaining mechanical confinement. This yields superior cycling stability (83% retention after 3600 cycles) and rate performance, guiding electrode surface engineering and advancing Sn-based anodes for sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 tin anode · sodium-ion battery · spatial confinement · Sn3(PO4)2 coating · dealloying

item.title: Programming Sodium-Storage Kinetics through Linear Quinone Oligomerization
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using linear quinone oligomerization (dimer vs. trimer) to tune sodium-storage kinetics, showing backbone extension reduces crystallinity and dissolution while lowering reorganization energy and HOMO–LUMO gap. Significance: 3BQ delivers 350 mA h g–1 and 80% retention after 500 cycles, establishing rational molecular design for advanced organic sodium-ion cathodes.
🏷 quinone oligomer · organic cathode · sodium-ion battery · sodiation kinetics · molecular design

item.title: Liquid Metal Interlayers Enable Zero-Pressure Sulfide Solid Electrolyte Lithium Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty is a room-temperature liquid NaK interlayer that stabilizes the lithium–sulfide solid electrolyte interface at nominally zero stack pressure, combining stress-free morphological adaptability with dissolved-Li-mediated transport. Its significance lies in enabling stable full-cell cycling (600 cycles, >2 mAh cm–2) without external pressure, offering a compliant interfacial design concept that accommodates morphological evolution while sustaining Li transport under minimal mechanical confinement.
🏷 solid electrolyte · lithium metal anode · NaK interlayer · zero-pressure · interfacial contact

item.title: Carbon Nanosheets‐Supported Asymmetric Co‐B 1 N 3 for High‐Rate Potassium Ion Batteries
item.description:

Carbon Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in synthesizing carbon nanosheet-supported asymmetric Co-B1N3 from coal tar pitch via electrostatic adsorption and heteroatom capture. This asymmetric coordination enhances K+ adsorption, lowers diffusion resistance, and promotes inorganic-rich SEI formation, yielding high capacity (356.6 mAh g−1), excellent rate capability (141.9 mAh g−1 at 5 A g−1), and 84.5% retention after 1200 cycles, offering a strategy for high-performance potassium-ion battery anodes.

item.title: Spin‐State Engineering via Asymmetric Defects for High‐Energy‐Efficiency Li–S Batteries: Unlocking Fast Sulfur Redox Through d‐p‐p Orbital Hybridization
item.description:

Carbon Energy | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in a "heteroatom-pinning" strategy that stabilizes sulfur vacancies via phosphorus doping, creating asymmetric Vs–P motifs that tune Fe spin states through d-p-p orbital hybridization. This spin engineering enables fast sulfur redox, yielding exceptional durability (0.030% decay/cycle, 86.6% efficiency over 1986 cycles) and rate performance, establishing spin configuration as a key activity descriptor for rational Li–S battery design.
🏷 lithium-sulfur battery · spin-state engineering · sulfur vacancy · orbital hybridization · polysulfide conversion
